verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence of bulk capability is read-only. The SOS references a Bulk data product for requestors and offers a downloadable list of active Notaries Public, but nothing shows bulk filing, bulk updates or batch actions across many entities, and filings sit behind per-entity User Access. Missing for 10: bulk filing or batch submission across many entities, bulk order or certificate requests, documented bulk-data access mechanics (format, API, scheduling), and any hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: If you are a requestor of Bulk data, the new entity numbers will be reflected in the files.
